record_title: First two unlabeled failure marginals identify heterogeneous proportional hazards
provenance: An exact elimination of the unknown common proportional-hazards baseline reduces the first two failure-time marginals to a uniquely identifiable finite exponential sum.
limitations: Independent continuous PHR components with strictly positive multipliers only; population-level identification may be numerically ill-conditioned for nearly equal hazards. Component labels and absolute hazard scale are not identified. The complete 1971 Pledger--Proschan chapter was not inspected theorem by theorem and older inverse-reliability literature remains a residual originality risk.
